title: Telling Neave her brother 'is at peace' resolves and closes 'Neave's Brother' as a normal completed quest, even though the game's own narration flags the line as false ('though you found nothing of him at all... It isn't the truth') — quest-done framing does not distinguish a true resolution from a comforting fabrication.
where: Ash Row (Emberfall) / tell her he's at peace
